map.验证、格式化与压缩 JSON 数据，所有操作在本地完成。: Validate, format and minify JSON data, with every operation done locally.
map.JSON 格式化按语法树递归输出：解析器先做词法分析（识别字符串、数字、true: JSON formatting outputs recursively along the syntax tree: the parser first runs lexical analysis (recognizing strings, numbers, true/false/null and brackets), then indents by level (2 spaces or a tab per level); minifying removes all structural whitespace and keeps only separators; when validation fails it reports the error position, and escape sequences inside strings must be paired and must not span lines.
map.格式化：自动校验 JSON 并以 2 空格缩进展示。: Format: validates the JSON automatically and shows it with 2-space indentation.
map.压缩：去除多余空白，生成单行 JSON。: Minify: strips extra whitespace to produce single-line JSON.
map.若 JSON 不合法，将高亮显示错误位置与原因。: If the JSON is invalid, the error position and reason are highlighted.
map.接口调试：把压缩成一行的响应体格式化展开，快速定位嵌套字段与缺失键，便于排查联调: API debugging: expand a response body that was minified into one line to quickly locate nested fields and missing keys, which helps troubleshoot integration problems.
map.配置巡检：对本地配置文件做语法校验，提前发现多余逗号、引号不匹配等导致解析失败的: Config review: syntax-check local config files to catch stray commas, mismatched quotes and other parse failures ahead of time.
map.体积对比：压缩冗余空白后再比较前后体积，用于评估传输优化空间与字段冗余。: Size comparison: minify redundant whitespace and compare the before/after size to assess the room for transmission optimization and field redundancy.
map.粘贴 {\"a\":1,\"b\":{\"c\":[1,2]}} 选择 2 空格: Paste {"a":1,"b":{"c":[1,2]}} and pick 2-space indentation; the tool outputs a readable structure with line breaks per level, and if there is a trailing comma it points out the exact line so you can fix it in place.
map.能校验 JSON 是否合法吗？: Can it validate whether JSON is legal?
map.可以，格式化前先做语法校验，非法位置会给出行号与原因；但仅校验语法，不校验业务字: Yes, it runs a syntax check before formatting and gives the line number and reason for invalid positions, but it only checks syntax, not the business meaning of fields.
map.解析在本地进行，体积过大时受浏览器内存限制；建议分片或仅粘贴关键片段，避免一次性: Parsing runs locally and large volumes are limited by browser memory; split the file or paste only key fragments to avoid processing very long text at once.
map.压缩只去除空白与换行，键名与值不变；若原文本含尾随逗号等非法结构会先拒绝处理并提: Minifying only removes whitespace and newlines, and keys and values stay unchanged; if the original text contains illegal structures such as a trailing comma, it is rejected first with a notice.
